title: Quest players defend against FPS attackers in a new way to game!
author: ClickClackMR
selftext:
2 years of “vibe coding” and my game is making insane strides. You wanted tougher enemies, who can be tougher than your gamer friends? 

1 player in their Meta Quest headset defends the map they create.

4 attacker players join  from any device with a browser and play FPS style against the replica of the map you create.  Play WASD with a M&K or Bluetooth Controller (touch not supported yet) 

Your buddies plant C4 in a video game and you watch your IRL house blow open. 4 friends breach your actual house, don’t let them in. 

Supporting any device with a browser that connects controller or mouse and keyboard. 

Beta starts 10/20/26 around 2pm EST
